//: Shipped Pi settings for the artifact-first skill suite. Paths are relative to the monorepo root. Install this file by merging the settings you need into ~/.pi/agent/settings.json or dropping a project-level .pi/settings.json override.

subagents.//: explore is read-only by allowlist; grant it extra READ-ONLY tools here. This example grants the lsp navigation set. researcher is read-only + web (web_search/web_fetch). general gets every discovered tool automatically; add names to excludeExtraTools to take some away.

researcher.//: web_search / web_fetch come from the web-fetch and web-search extension packages loaded above. If they aren't loaded, researcher degrades to the core read-only tools.

statusline.//: Absolute degradation budget: >effectiveLimit tokens = caveman. Thresholds are fractions of the limit. Env EFFECTIVE_LIMIT / Z_* override.

lsp.//: Add or override language servers without touching the Extension package dir; merged over the shipped servers.json.
